WM. MCGIRR,
for Indian Commissioner.

It is impossible to show the result of the gardens, as the produce was eaten as soon as it came to maturity. In many cases where the grain
has not been threshed, it is shown approximately. Although horses we shown as the private property of Indians, still they are but ponies,
and in many cases unfitted for any work on a farm.
